page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (EUROPÆA, Tritbemius, Bertius, Germania, Xiphilinus, Antonino) and a running head at top. Page number 516 at top left, running head "Antoninus Pius" at top centre, and "Lib. II" at top right.

main_text.p: EVROPÆA In GERMANIA vici Antoninus Germanicus, Marcomiri filius, ubi bem Hetruscorum ad Mocnum inflauravit, & Auctoris Lucasvite Nequis vero Syndi Frisi... Tritbemius Bertius 3. ...

Nequis vero Syndi Frisiorum ad Danubium ... consedit. Alii tamen illudunt Carolum Magnum ... referunt, & verius: hoc ad Gediminum ab Hierosolymis ... berg. Apud SICAMBROS excepit Marcomannos ... Clodomirus.
BRITANNOS per Lollium legatum Siluum cum Gibmovit Antoninus & muro cohortibus barbaros arcuit.

SUB ANTONINO floruere Philemon Tusc- nus qui Olympiades Graecorum libri ... scripsit: Pausanias qui vel cum Graecum reliquit: Dio Pilliam Lucius Mecatus Antiquarius ... Iulius Bertius, Platonicus Philippus Studiolus ... redit fec.t, & cui Antonius Salarium ...

Xiphilinus Antoninus Dionis: Nihil ... ora ... mo credidiit ... civitate ... Regis ... Maximus Tirus ... Aurelii praeceptor Crispus Caesar, qui cum ... Diogenes ... Tandem ... temporis martyrio coronati ... Droxanus Iuvenis qui vitas Philosophorum descripsit: Iohannes ... Geographica reliquit ... Hadrianus ... Iudaei ... Rhetor, qui ... Tutorem ... in Africa le Ipsum a cauda medium contentum.

page.notes: Much of the page is faded and show-through from the reverse side is heavy; many words in the left margin and body lines are illegible and have been transcribed approximately, with uncertain readings not individually marked. Lines in the lower half are largely unreadable.
